course_title: The Psychology of People at Work
course_description: This course examines how we can use psychology to enhance the productivity, safety and well-being of people at work. It examines the psychological factors influencing the effectiveness of individuals, teams and organisations, and considers how we can use that knowledge to develop interventions to improve these outcomes.
timetable:
The timetable for this course is available on the
UQ Public Timetable
.
course_aims: The aim of this course is to develop your understanding of human behaviour in business and organisational settings, and how this can be used to develop interventions that enhance productivity, safety and well-being.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify the psychological factors influencing the effectiveness of individuals, teams, and organisations in relation to productivity, safety, and well-being.
Evaluate and diagnose real organisational problems.
Select and apply evidence-based interventions to enhance productivity, safety, and well-being in diverse business environments.
Communicate evidence-based arguments and recommendations for enhancing productivity, safely, and well-being to a business audience.
Demonstrate teamwork behaviours to resolve complex, real-world challenges in the field of business psychology.

assessment_details.title: Case study analysis
assessment_details.task_description: You are a consultant who has been hired to help an organisation with a challenge that they are facing. In this task, you will describe the context of the organisational challenge, diagnose what the issue is, and apply theories and concepts from the course to demonstrate your understanding of the issue.
